steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Cross Civic Square, and the highest building over there is the City Hall.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: What's up, everyone!! Thank you all for coming out here! This is... D— D— D——!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: (Thunderous cheering)

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: We're all gathered here on this scorching summer day for the same purpose... and that is—

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: MUSIC!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: What was that? I couldn't hear you! Gimme your loudest voice, and let the whole city know what you want!!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: M U S I C ! ! ! !

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: In that case... put your hands up! Let's go!!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: This is an everyday occurrence during the Obsidian Festival. After all, the concerts are one of the most beloved things about the Festival.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The major concert starts at night in Garrison Amusement Park, while at daytime, you can see small concerts in every district.

options: This kind of music is a bit intense for me...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Haha, but you know what, I studied in Victoria, so I prefer more elegant music and classical.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Even though classical artists are invited to the Obsidian Festival, this kind of music is more attractive to the tourists.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It started trending the last few years or so. When I was younger, jazz was all the rage.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I love spending the day on 2nd Avenue. With a few books with me, I can stay an entire day in one of the cafés.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Listening to music, having  a cup of green tea, and enjoying the sea breeze...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It was then that I thought, Siesta must be the best city in the world.

options: You must really love this city.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Of course! This is all possible due to the support I have, including from my family.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Besides my father, someone close to me works at the City Hall here.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You'll meet her soon. With her help, it will be much easier to determine how serious the problem is!

options: It sounds like you really trust her.
Are you talking about your mother?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: My mother died when she gave birth to me. After that, my father buried himself in his work.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Since I was little, she has been taking care of me as my bodyguard. Her name is Schwarz.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Whenever my father was busy with work, she patiently kept my company. Though we're not related by blood, she treats me just like a sister would, so I consider her to be an important part of my family.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'll introduce you to her when we meet.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Look, Doctor, we're almost there. Let's head straight in.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Mister Cronin, Miss Ceylon would like to see you.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: What important matters bring you to the City Hall, milady?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Everyone is busy organizing the festival right now, so I'm afraid there is little time to spare.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Cronin, I'll get to the point. The Siesta Volcano is likely to erupt soon. I can't say exactly when, but it could be as soon as the next few days.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: In other words, all the citizens and tourists will be in danger. We need to start evacuating them and help them find shelter.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: We must stop the Obsidian Festival right away.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Oh milady, do you know what you're saying?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Anyone else would have been driven out the moment they talked to me like that.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: But because you're special, I'm willing to explain it just for you.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: You don't have to worry about the volcano 'issue' at all. Even though I don't know where you got your information, I can assure you that it's nonsense.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...Are you kidding me?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: There's plenty of evidence that suggests that the volcano is active again and will likely erupt soon.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Such as?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Agitation of the Originium slugs living there, unusual changes in temperature, and a strange smell. The conclusion should be obvious.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If you don't believe me, read the material I brought. It contains a detailed analysis and the conclusion.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Obvious? Did you go interview the Originium slugs? Or maybe the hot air, or that strange smell?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: I don't quite understand. What do these baseless numbers have to do with this so-called imminent eruption?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: All I know is, I designed the volcano observation system, the mayor built it, and it is still working well.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Right now, the Siesta Volcano's parameters aren't much different from previous years. If anything, they're even more stable?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What are you talking about? The truth is right before you...

options: You're a Catastrophe Messenger, and you don't even know this much?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: And who exactly are you?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} is from a professional organization, with colleagues who are experts in volcanology.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: These parameters were examined by the analysts from their specialized department.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: I see, I see.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: ...Haha, I get it now.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: So it was you bunch who managed to fool the mayor's daughter, strange visitors.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Milady, isn't it obvious? You were duped by this faceless stranger.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Cronin, what are you trying to say? You don't even believe my word?!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: What I'm saying is, you've been studying abroad so you might not know this, but many people are jealous of Siesta's development.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: These kinds of people appear every year. They've tried every trick in the book to try to stop our development. Blackmail, explosions, assassinations. They've even targeted no-name people like me.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Of course, this is not the first time that someone has tried to spread rumors about this so-called 'volcanic eruption.' However, it is the first time one of these rumors has even been able to deceive someone like you.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: I must say, these grifters must have done their homework on the mayor. They even knew that you just returned from studying abroad.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: And look at their nerve, marching into the City Hall like they own the place.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...You're right that I didn't know about this, but I'm telling the truth!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: There's no way I'd just trust any stranger who shows up!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: As far as I can tell, there's no difference between this 'Doctor' and the swindlers I've encountered in the past.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: There's no depths to which they won't stoop in order to take away this city!

options: If this is a joke, it's not very funny.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Jumping to conclusions? Hah, that's what all you swindlers say.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: What a coincidence. I didn't find your little joke funny either.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Milady, you're still young, so things like this are bound to happen sometimes.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: But don't worry, these swindlers will be punished accordingly. This, I promise you.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Security.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Take them away.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Cronin! You won't even listen to me now?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You won't have your way as long as I'm here!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: What a pity then. I can't just stand by and watch you disturb Siesta's order.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Hurry and arrest these con-artists already.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Also, suppress Miss Ceylon as well. Don't hurt her though; just let her calm down a little!

options: Hurry! We need to get out of here!
